from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Extracted attributes for a single judgment document to support classification."""
    title: str = Field(description="The official title or identifier of the document")
    case_type: str = Field(description="The broad legal domain: Administrative, Criminal, Civil, or Execution")
    legal_issue: str = Field(description="The specific subject matter of the dispute (e.g., 'Lawyer Penalty', 'Social Security', 'Land Expropriation')")
    procedural_stage: str = Field(description="The specific procedural context or action (e.g., 'Retrial', 'Execution Reconsideration', 'Civil Suit')")
    key_parties: list[str] = Field(description="Key entities involved (e.g., 'Justice Bureau', 'Company', 'Defendant')")
    classification_evidence: str = Field(description="The core factual finding or legal basis used to identify the case category")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregated extraction results for all documents."""
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
